name: oasis-published-content
prerequisites: Available content connector, exact page/parent or document target, configured release identity, managed content shape and requested language set.

scenarios.trigger: Exact page contains one managed region with older release
scenarios.expected: Replace only that region and verify readback.

scenarios.trigger: Page parent or artifact identity differs
scenarios.expected: Stop before mutation with the mismatch.

scenarios.trigger: Manual edits create two possible managed regions
scenarios.expected: Prepare options and request the actual deletion/scope decision.
